integrity: A constructive proof and a proof of the obstruction are supplied. The standalone Python script replays finite cases; it is not a finite proof of all cases.
scientific_limitations: Only the short/two-edge mixed spider family with a>=1, b>=2 is classified globally. Other arm-length patterns and target profiles when a>=2 are not classified. Publication priority and the infinite argument have not been independently audited.
title: Cup stackability of spiders with unit and two-edge arms
